digits hidden: millions, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$1.5 million in expenses”
the unit phrase on the top label: “$1.5 million in expenses”; the top gridline starts after it
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: Operations, HR, Finance (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)
highlighted in the strong shade of their colour: Central (Operations), West (HR); the others keep their colour
